overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board lawfully entered executive session under Purpose 6 to discuss release of a CDBG forgivable DPL lien, because the town holds the lien and must assess property value and negotiate repayment.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board convened in executive session on January 15 without a lawful purpose, by discussing release of a CDBG forgivable DPL lien on a property.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it discussed release of a HUD Community Development Block Grant forgivable DPL in executive session under Purpose 6.
